description.nails: IND Nails are removable tips designed for the professional display of nail colors and nail art. They can be placed directly on the finger, allowing for a realistic assessment of the color against the hand. They offer an innovative and versatile display solution. Minimum order quantity: 30 pieces.
description.display: The IND Display Strip is a minimalist display unit featuring double-sided adhesive tape-suitable for almost any shelving unit in the beauty and nail styling industries.
description.magnetic: IND Magnetic Nails are removable tips designed for the professional presentation of nail polish colors and nail art. These tips can be tried on directly on the finger, allowing for a realistic visualization of the color on the hand. When combined with the IND Rahmendisplay, IND Schrankdisplay, and IND Displayleiste, they form an innovative and versatile display solution. Minimum order quantity: 10 pieces.
description.transparent: IND Transparent Nail Tips are removable swatches designed for the professional presentation of nail polish colors and nail art. They can be tried on directly, allowing for a realistic visualization of the color on the hand. When paired with the IND display rail, they offer an innovative and versatile display solution. Minimum order quantity: 30 pieces.
description.frame: IND Frame Display is a modern, framed display designed for the elegant presentation of nail colors and designs. Ideal for beauty salons and retail stores, it helps organize your collection while ensuring a clear, attractive display. It can be wall-mounted or used as a freestanding unit, offering a stylish and professional look.
description.cabinet: IND Cabinet Display combines elegant presentation with practical storage. Its exterior resembles a classic framed display, while the interior features shelves for organizing nail accessories. The cabinet opens for easy access to its contents and can be placed on a countertop or mounted on the wall.
